children: Global Village has announced that Season 31 will open on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, running until May 2027 under the theme ‘A More Wonderful World’.
The Dubai destination will introduce new attractions, experiences and entertainment alongside returning favourites.
Celebrating three decades since its launch in 1997, Global Village has become a major fixture in Dubai’s cultural and entertainment calendar, welcoming millions of visitors.
Season 31 will continue its focus on multicultural pavilions, live entertainment, dining, shopping and family experiences, with further announcements expected ahead of opening.
